correctness.rationale: By the finite homogeneous graph classification, a graph or complement is t disjoint equal-sized cliques or an exceptional C5 or 3×3 rook graph. Occupied cliques inject into distinct target cliques; this yields R=Σ_s binom(t,s)(t)_s(B_n(z)−1)^s with B_n=Σ_j binom(n,j)^2 j! z^j. Complement induces identical partial isomorphism monoid. For exceptions, orbit-stabilizer counts each induced-domain isomorphism: C5 coefficients [1,25,100,100,50,10], rook [1,81,1296,5616,9072,9072,6048,2592,648,72], total 34,498, independently verified by explicit group actions on all subsets. For fixed t, s=t dominates as T_n=n!L_n(−1)→∞; local deficiency weights binom(n,j)/j! have ratios (n−j)/(j+1)^2, yielding (J_n−sqrt(n))/n^(1/4)⇒N(0,1/2). Independence of t components implies total variance t/2. Classical Laguerre asymptotic gives stated total-size factor t!(n!)^t e^(2t√n−t/2)/(2√π)^t n^(t/4).
